items.text: NPTEL, the government-backed course platform run with the IITs and IISc, states that joining a course is free, including videos, study material and assignments.

supporting: NPTEL, the government-backed course platform run with the IITs and IISc, states that joining a course is free, including videos, study material and assignments. Its FAQ lists a certification exam fee of Rs 1000 per course.

To pass, a learner needs at least 40 out of 100 in the average assignment score and at least 40 out of 100 in the final exam, with assignments weighted 25 percent and the exam 75 percent. Some courses have different rules, so check the course announcement page.
